questions.prompt: In which mountain range does Mount Everest stand?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest rises in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas on the border between Nepal and China.

questions.prompt: Into which body of water does the Nile River empty?
questions.explanation: The Nile flows northward through northeastern Africa and forms a wide delta where it empties into the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.prompt: On which continent is the Amazon rainforest located?
questions.explanation: The Amazon rainforest spans the Amazon basin of South America, with the largest share located within Brazil.

questions.prompt: The English Channel separates Great Britain from which mainland European country?
questions.explanation: The English Channel is the arm of the Atlantic Ocean that separates southern England from northern France.

questions.prompt: Which imaginary line circles the Earth at zero degrees latitude?
questions.explanation: The Equator is defined as zero degrees latitude, dividing the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres, whereas the Prime Meridian marks zero degrees longitude.

questions.prompt: In which US state is the Grand Canyon located?
questions.explanation: Carved by the Colorado River, the Grand Canyon lies entirely within northern Arizona.

questions.prompt: The Great Barrier Reef lies in the Coral Sea off the northeastern coast of which country?
questions.explanation: The Great Barrier Reef stretches for more than 2,300 kilometres off the coast of Queensland, Australia.

questions.prompt: The Mediterranean island of Sicily is part of which country?
questions.explanation: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea and is an autonomous region of Italy, separated from the Italian mainland by the Strait of Messina.

questions.prompt: Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest peak in Africa, is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant stratovolcano in northeastern Tanzania, near its northern border with Kenya.

questions.prompt: Which two oceans are connected by the Panama Canal?
questions.explanation: Cutting across the Isthmus of Panama, the Panama Canal links the Atlantic Ocean (via the Caribbean Sea) with the Pacific Ocean.

questions.prompt: Spain and Portugal occupy nearly all of which European peninsula?
questions.explanation: The Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe is divided primarily between Spain and Portugal, along with Andorra and Gibraltar.

questions.prompt: Which is the deepest lake in the world?
questions.explanation: Lake Baikal, a rift lake in southern Siberia, reaches a depth of about 1,642 metres, making it the deepest lake on Earth; Lake Tanganyika is the second deepest.

questions.prompt: The microstate of Andorra lies in the Pyrenees mountains between which two countries?
questions.explanation: Andorra is a landlocked principality in the eastern Pyrenees bordered exclusively by France to the north and Spain to the south.

questions.prompt: In which ocean is the Mariana Trench, the deepest known part of the world's oceans, located?
questions.explanation: The Mariana Trench lies in the western Pacific Ocean east of the Mariana Islands, reaching its greatest depth at the Challenger Deep.

questions.prompt: Angel Falls, the world's highest terrestrial waterfall, is located in which South American country?
questions.explanation: Angel Falls in Canaima National Park, Venezuela, has a total height of 979 metres (including an 807-metre main plunge) from the Auyán-tepui tabletop mountain.

questions.prompt: Which sovereign country is an enclave completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.explanation: The Kingdom of Lesotho is entirely encircled by South Africa; Eswatini borders both South Africa and Mozambique.

questions.prompt: Into which landlocked body of water does the Volga, the longest river in Europe, empty?
questions.explanation: The Volga flows southward across Russia into the endorheic Caspian Sea; the Don empties into the Sea of Azov and the Danube and Dnieper into the Black Sea.

questions.prompt: Which island in Maritime Southeast Asia is politically divided among Indonesia, Malaysia, and Brunei?
questions.explanation: Borneo is divided among three sovereign countries: Indonesian Kalimantan in the south and centre, the Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak in the north, and the Sultanate of Brunei.

questions.prompt: Along with Liechtenstein, which Central Asian republic is one of the world's only two doubly landlocked countries?
questions.explanation: Uzbekistan is bordered only by five other landlocked countries (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Afghanistan, and Turkmenistan), making it doubly landlocked.

questions.prompt: Which body of water lies between Cape Horn at the tip of South America and the South Shetland Islands of Antarctica?
questions.explanation: The Drake Passage connects the southwestern Atlantic (Scotia Sea) with the southeastern Pacific and separates the southern tip of South America from Antarctica.
